programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: Airing from 2005 to 2009 on NBC, the game show series returns to primetime TV with original host Howie Mandel. A contestant must choose from 26 sealed briefcases containing a marker for various amounts of cash -- from one penny to $1 million. The player then eliminates the remaining 25 cases one by one. The chosen ones are opened and the amount of money inside revealed. After several cases are opened, the player is tempted by the Banker to accept an offer of cash in exchange for not continuing the game and possibly winning a larger sum of money.

Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Bill Farmer, Jason Marsden and Wallace Shawn.

Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

Animated adventure, with the voices of Eva Gabor, Phil Harris and Scatman Crothers.

Animated comedy, with the voices of John Goodman, Billy Crystal, Steve Buscemi and James Coburn.

Comedy adventure based on the 1980s cartoon series, starring Matthew Broderick, Rupert Everett and Joely Fisher.

Wes Anderson's comedy drama, starring Bill Murray, Owen Wilson, Cate Blanchett, Willem Dafoe and Jeff Goldblum.

Sci-fi action sequel, starring Steven Pasquale, Reiko Aylesworth and John Ortiz.

Wes Anderson's comedy drama, starring Ralph Fiennes, Tony Revolori, F Murray Abraham and Jude Law.

Animation, featuring the voices of John Fiedler, Jim Cummings and Andre Stojka.

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E11 — BirminghamJames visits the capital of the balti - Birmingham. Here he meets acclaimed food critic, broadcaster, columnist and author, Grace Dent. Swapping the mini for a narrow boat, James takes in the culture, which saw an industrial revolution. James's trip down the stretch of the 35-mile canal system inspires him to cook his version of a chicken balti. Grace explores the revolution of Birmingham and its food scene by starting at the famous Balti Triangle.

programme.desc: S2 E1 — Battersea & HammersmithMichel Roux tries pizza, visits Battersea Power Station and a 16th-century garden. He cooks cacio e pepe, chocolate mousse, and a summer salad.

programme.title: Roux Down the River
programme.desc: S2 E2 — Greenwich & SouthwarkMichel Roux visits a two-star Trivet, the Cutty Sark ship and a historic riverside pub, making pork gnocchi, red mullet, mushroom millefeuille and fruit soup.

programme.title: Roux Down the River
programme.desc: S2 E3 — WindsorMichel Roux finds the perfect fish and chips and visits Monkey Island at Royal Windsor. He cooks a mackerel burger, shepherd's pie, and a peach meringue.

programme.title: Roux Down the River
programme.desc: S2 E4 — Sonning & ReadingCanoeing gives Michel a different view as he visits a watermill. He encounters a Hong Kong tea barge serving up crêpes Suzette and croissant and butter pudding.

programme.title: Roux Down the River
programme.desc: S2 E5 — Goring & WallingfordMichel Roux enjoys the high life, cooking up a lamb stew, roast duck, halibut with saffron and sherry, and a summer pudding.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Laurence Llewelyn-BowenDesigner Lawrence Llewellyn-Bowen drops in as Prue shares her recipe for a peppercorn-infused chocolate cake and how to pull off the perfect homemade pizza.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives ᴺᵉʷ

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives ᴺᵉʷ

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S7 E7 — You Can Say That AgainGuy Fieri visits America's most interesting and unique restaurants. Guy visits an old gas station in Houston, Texas, which serves up authentic Greek specialties like moussaka and loukoumades.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S7 E8 — Barbecued, Baked and BrinedGuy Fieri visits America's most interesting and unique restaurants. Guy visits a family restaurant in Idaho which serves up brick oven pizza and remarkable salads.

programme.desc: A look back at the history and legacy of the charity football match in aid of Unicef as it celebrates a milestone 20 years. programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: S2 E5 — AitchRapper Aitch faces autistic, neurodivergent and learning-disabled interviewers, opening up about fame, identity and the nuances of being white in a typically black music genre. As the questions come thick and fast, Aitch reflects on his lyrics and the language he used early in his career, admitting he felt pressure to say certain things as a young rapper - and that he got it wrong.

programme.title: When English Football Ruled Europe
programme.desc: S1 E2Part two of two. programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: S2 E4On the sweeping sands of Benone Strand in Co Derry, Dermot O'Leary rolls up his trousers and wades into the sea to harvest water for salt-making, learning the traditional process of creating sea salt over an open fire right on the beach. Travelling on to Coleraine, Dermot tries lobster fishing and visits LIR seafood restaurant, where the chefs champion a zero-waste approach to cooking.

programme.title: The Goonies

But when they begin their search for the vessel, they find the evil Mama Fratelli standing in the way of a fantastic adventure.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E20 — New YorkThe chef ends his coast-to-coast exploration of the US in New York City. He chooses his favourite pair, Daniel, run by his old mate Daniel Boulud, and Le Bernadine, where Eric Ripart is in charge. At the end of the day, James cooks back on the pier as sunset approaches and he reminisces on his journey of more than 3,000 miles.

programme.title: How To Lose A War
programme.desc: E5Examining how each Axis Power had troubles on their own home front, leading to disaster in the final days of the war.

programme.title: The Abyss: Rise And Fall Of The Nazis
programme.desc: E1In the wake of the First World War, Adolf Hitler identifies Benito Mussolini as his model and has one ultimate goal: to gain power in Germany.

programme.title: The Abyss: Rise And Fall Of The Nazis
programme.desc: E2Hitler appears to be eliminated after his failed putsch in 1923. Discover how the Nazi movement used democracy's tolerance in Germany to achieve a comeback with agitation and violence.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The Avro Lancaster is the legendary British heavy bomber that carved its place in history with Bomber Command during World War 2. That conflict saw over seven thousand of these iconic aircraft come off the production line.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E3Four railway journeys that changed modern history: 24-year-old Winston Churchill boarded an armoured train during the Boer War hoping for a newspaper scoop.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: E7Encouraged by Nazi brutality, Soviet partisans took up arms, creating big 'no-go' areas for German troops. This is a look at their efforts from the Russian perspective.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E5This episode tells stories about the secret world of naval deception and cloak and dagger missions. 1914, the yacht Asgard, manned by Erskine Childers, smuggled rifles into a fishing village to arm an Irish militia in their struggle for Home Rule.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E6The 16th century witnessed a revolution in combat ship design and saw the birth of two legendary sea captains; Sir John Hawkins and Sir Francis Drake – both superb seamen and adventurers who would have a lasting impact on naval history.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The Avro Lancaster is the legendary British heavy bomber that carved its place in history with Bomber Command during World War 2. That conflict saw over seven thousand of these iconic aircraft come off the production line.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2Unusually, we look at the later, clipped wing version flown by Czech refugee pilots in the UK during WW2. We get close-up with a beautifully restored example, fly her and unearth long unseen test and operational footage.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E6From the Indian border in Burma to China, which has been at war with Japan since 1937, the war grows more savage. In Europe, despite having less resources than when he first made the attempt, Hitler renews his assault on the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E8The bloodiest months of the war are still ahead. A Soviet surge pushes German forces back to within 30 kilometres of the Polish Border. The siege at Leningrad is lifted after 900 days and Operation Overlord, D-Day, opens a second front in Europe.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E5Twenty-four-year-old Winston Churchill boarded an armoured train during the Boer War hoping for a newspaper scoop. He was captured, but became world famous after escaping.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E6The story of the trench warfare from the First World War is well known. What is less well known is that the efficiency of the railway networks of both sides helped cause that stalemate.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E1In the waters of Scapa Flow, discover sunken dreadnoughts that tell the story of how a U-Boat sank HMS Royal Oak. Later, on HMS Cavalier, we explore how a raid by commandos called Operation Chariot proved the vulnerability of the battleship.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E2The episode begins with the story of HMS Conqueror sinking the General Belgrano during the Falklands War. Later, a crew member from the USS Nautilus describes what it was like to serve on the world's first nuclear submarine.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3Often called 'the forgotten bomber', the mighty North American twin delivered the first blow in the fight back against Japan, in one of the most daring and audacious raids of all time.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4Cruelly called 'the packing case the B17 came in,' the Liberator more than proved its worth over Europe and the Pacific, patterning the B17 to deliver a blow to the axis powers in WWII however it wasn't simply a bomb delivery system.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E1In the north of Crete, six commandos land in a cove. On this island that has been occupied for two years, they have been given a high-risk mission—to infiltrate the Heraklion airfield to destroy the Luftwaffe bombers and fighter planes.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E2December 7th, 1942. Off the coast of France, ten British commandos board five canoes in the middle of the ocean. Their objective: to paddle to the Gironde estuary, then up the river to Bordeaux to sabotage German ships.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: E5After a poor start to the war, the Soviet Air Force fought back with brilliant aircraft designs. This is a look at their domination of the skies from the Russian viewpoint.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: E6The Soviet Union's submarines courted huge controversy in 1945 when they caused massive losses of life at sea. This is a look at the naval war from the Russian perspective.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E3At Stalingrad, the German 6th Army is destroyed by the Soviets. It’s the first major defeat of the Third Reich, which marks the beginning of its decline. Elsewhere, after the American victory at Guadalcanal, Japan loses the initiative in the Pacific.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E4Operation Overlord is launched. With the Normandy Landings, the Allies pierce the Atlantic Wall. In the East, the Red Army sweeps through Belarus with Operation Bagration, annihilating the Wehrmacht. The end of the Third Reich is near.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E6From the Indian border in Burma to China, which has been at war with Japan since 1937, the war grows more savage. In Europe, despite having less resources than when he first made the attempt, Hitler renews his assault on the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E8The bloodiest months of the war are still ahead. A Soviet surge pushes German forces back to within 30 kilometres of the Polish Border. The siege at Leningrad is lifted after 900 days and Operation Overlord, D-Day, opens a second front in Europe.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: E3Soviet troops suffered huge casualties in Rzhev in 1941, causing the bloody battle to be grimly nicknamed the Meat-Grinder. This is a look at events from the Russian perspective.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: E4An attack on Soviet oil fields could have won the Germans the war, but massive resistance thwarted Hitler's dream.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2Unusually, we look at the later, clipped wing version flown by Czech refugee pilots in the UK during WW2. We get close-up with a beautifully restored example, fly her and unearth long unseen test and operational footage.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E5Twenty-four-year-old Winston Churchill boarded an armoured train during the Boer War hoping for a newspaper scoop. He was captured, but became world famous after escaping.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E1During WWII, the French Resistance seeks aid from SOE. Led by Vera Atkins, Odette Sansom and Noor Inayat Khan fight the Nazis, risking it all for victory.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E2Vera enlists Violette Szabo and Yvonne Baseden. With circuits failing and Noor at risk, treachery allegations harm preparations for the Allied invasion.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E3With Allied victories and the liberation of Paris following D-Day, Vera is in a race against time to locate her missing agents.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E4Armed with evidence from Odette, Vera intensifies her search at Karlsruhe prison and Ravensbruck, facing hurdles to uncover crucial results in Germany.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E5Vera finds out her agents' fate. Her beliefs about Noor are challenged. Suspicions lead Vera to hunt down a Nazi mastermind.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E6Capture of a key Nazi uncovers shocking realities. Amid demands for accountability, as Vera and her team navigate murky waters to confront uncomfortable truths.

programme.title: Cracking The Code
programme.desc: E1Uncovering some of the world’s most famous encryptions. Revealing how they were decoded, the brilliant minds who cracked them and the mysteries they were hiding.

programme.title: Cracking The Code
programme.desc: E3The Japanese Super Code reveals the US efforts to crack Japan's unbreakable WWII code following the horror of the attack on Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: Cracking The Code
programme.desc: E6A look at America's Cold War codebreakers charged with unravelling a seemingly uncrackable Soviet code and the uncovering of the Manhattan Project.

programme.title: Cracking The Code
programme.desc: E7Revealing the encrypted German telegram could save Britain in its darkest hour. Can a team of geniuses decode the message in time?
